impl Environment {
    fn directories(&self) {
        #[cfg(windows)]
        {

            directories.push(local_data.join("Programs/OpenAI/Codex/bin"));
            directories.push(
                self.values
                    .get(std::ffi::OsStr::new("APPDATA"))
                    .map_or_else(|| home.join("AppData/Roaming"), PathBuf::from)
                    .join("npm"),
            );
            directories.push(local_data.join("Programs/nodejs"));

            if let Some(program_files) = self.values.get(std::ffi::OsStr::new("PROGRAMFILES")) {
                directories.push(PathBuf::from(program_files).join("nodejs"));
            }

        }
    }
}
